segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְכֵן מִי שֶׁהָיָה יֵינוֹ בְּתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר וְאֵירְעוֹ אֵבֶל אוֹ אוֹנֶס אוֹ שֶׁהִטְעוּהוּ — זוֹלֵף וְגוֹמֵר וְגָף כְּדַרְכּוֹ, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יוֹסֵי. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: עוֹשֶׂה לוֹ לִימּוּדִים בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁלֹּא יַחְמִיץ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And similarly,» with regard to «one whose wine was» already «in the» collection «pit» beside the wine press and needed to be removed lest it sour, «and mourning» for some close relative «or» some other «unavoidable accident befell him, or» his workers «misled him,» promising to come but failing to do so, during the intermediate days of the Festival «he may draw off» the wine «and complete» the process, «and» then «plug» each barrel of wine «in its» usual «manner;» this is «the statement of Rabbi Yosei. Rabbi Yehuda says: He should construct a wooden panel» to cover the collection pit «so that» the wine «will not sour.»

moves.cueHe: וכן מי שהיה יינו בתוך הבור
moves.summary: R' Yosei: he may draw off, complete and plug normally
R' Yehuda: only cover the pit with panels

edges.cueHe: דברי רבי יוסי. רבי יהודה אומר
edges.about: whether one whose wine is in the collection pit may complete and plug it in the usual manner on chol hamoed or only cover the pit with a panel

positions.claim: he may draw off, complete and plug in the usual manner
he only covers the pit with panels so it will not sour
